course_summary:
ISEN 620 | Survey of Optimization | Summer 2026
Instructor: Sergiy Butenko | butenko@tamu.edu
Meets: Asynchronous | Online
Grading: Exams [80%], Homework Quizzes [15%], Lecture Quizzes [5%] — A: [90,100], B: [80,90), C: [70,80), D: [60,70), F: [0,60)
Topics: K-K-T conditions, Karush-Kuhn-Tucker Conditions, Lagrange conditions, Simplex Method in Matrix Form, Complementary Slackness, Steepest Descent Method, Newton's Method, Conjugate Direction Methods, Root Finding, Line Search, FONC for Unconstrained Problems, FONC for Equality Constraints, Second Order Optimality Conditions, Graphical Method, Simplex Method: Termination, Simplex Method: Initialization, Analysis of the Simplex Method, LP Duality, Sensitivity Analysis, IP Modeling, LP Modeling, LP Assumptions, Introduction to Optimization Software, linear programming theory, nonlinear programming theory, linear programming algorithms, nonlinear programming algorithms, linear optimization models, nonlinear optimization models, small-scale optimization problems, large-scale problems, deterministic linear optimization, nonlinear optimization, linear programming, unconstrained-nonlinear optimization, constrained-nonlinear optimization, numerical algorithms
Tools: AMPL, Excel, Canvas, Zoom, GroupMe, YouTube, Google Drive
Prerequisites: MATH 304 or MATH 311
